renderer: single native transparent video; real alpha probe, VP9 preferred, HEVC fallback
loopCount: replays every few seconds (first and last frame are identical)
edgeTreatment: source-derived local white-plate alpha solve in edge band; preserve white-shoe matte; invisible RGB padding; straight-alpha HEVC
interpolation: 24 fps: every second frame of the RIFE 48 fps master (c10), so the file is a third the size and buffers without stalls
retouch: inner-leg bounce-light smear toned down, mild interior sharpen (.work/polish_c10.py); alpha untouched
